propositions: The batched-map transient recovery test recovers its batched Git walk but compares the exact SHA against None from a one-shot per-event oracle read, causing flaky failures.

Production resolve_event_commit intentionally returns None for all Git errors, timeouts, and exceptions per its fail-closed contract at src/rebar/attest/authorship_resolution.py:21-23 and must not change.

A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit with at most five identical retry attempts must replace all direct one-shot resolve_event_commit calls in the equivalence oracle to mirror the batched fixture's recovery mechanism.
Transient failures rc128, rc0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) injected into per-event git-log must recover on identical retry with exact position-to-SHA equivalence preserved.
Persistent per-event failures must stop after exactly five attempts and raise diagnostics with fsck and count-objects object-store evidence without changing any production source code.
